shared_elements: arms/hands indicated on a human body
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces include schematic anthropomorphic figures with arms indicated, a near-universal motif. A is a crowded two-dimensional panel of linear outline drawings dominated by boat-like curved forms, cup-marks/discs and small stick-like figures, whereas B is a single large frontal three-dimensional standing figure with a modelled head and hands brought to the belly, with no scene, no repetition and no accompanying motifs.
